tool.title: Run a layer's PR checks
tool.description: Dispatch the layer's `harness-pr-checks.yml`, which calls the tools layer's reusable `layer-pr-checks.yml` (mount the pinned layers, run every gate of the layer's dependency harness, compare head against base) and, on main, `layer-main-qa.yml`. The workflow is the Tool: its helper scripts (run-gates, compare-gates, main-verdict, …) are its steps. Started with the standard GitHub CLI; the run is watched with `gh run watch`.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The repository whose workflow is run. Default: the current one.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: The branch to run it on. Default: the default branch.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: The dispatched run; its outcome is read with `gh run watch` or `gh run view`.

selection.when: Running the `harness-pr-checks.yml` workflow on demand instead of waiting for its trigger, or finding which workflow a CI step belongs to.
selection.limits: Needs a token that may dispatch workflows (actions: write) on the repository.
selection.cost: A full CI run on GitHub's runners.

remedies.none: The workflow runs on GitHub; with no host there is nothing to dispatch. The scripts it runs can still be run locally by their own keys.
